title: Global functions on a limit of qcqs schemes
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ whose transition morphisms are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism] and with every $S_i$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]; let $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ with projections $f_i:S\to S_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Then the ring maps $f_i^\sharp:\Gamma(S_i,\mathcal O_{S_i})\to\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ induce an isomorphism $\varinjlim_i\Gamma(S_i,\mathcal O_{S_i})\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]: every $a\in\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ is $f_i^\sharp(a_i)$ for some $i$ and some $a_i\in\Gamma(S_i,\mathcal O_{S_i})$, and if $f_i^\sharp(a_i)=0$ then $f_{i'i}^\sharp(a_i)=0$ for some $i'\ge i$.

source.place: Limits, Lemma Tag 01Z0 (lemma-descend-section, line 434), in Situation 01YZ-descent (situation-descent), the case F_0 = O_{S_0} (f^*O = O)
